desc.zh: 点一下按钮调用 setCount(c => c + 1)，React 并不是立刻去改网页上的 DOM 节点。这篇按 React 19.3.1 的源码，把这一行拆开：JSX 返回的不可变对象、Fiber 单链表和双缓冲、两轮 O(n) 列表 Diff 与 key、按调用顺序排队的 Hook 链表、子树脏标记冒泡、Commit 三阶段与 Effect 时机、根容器事件委托与微任务批处理、31 位 Lanes 优先级调度，以及 2026 年 11 月的 React Compiler、Server Components 与 Activity/ViewTransition 前沿。九个可以动手的模型，全部按同一套算法重写并和真正的 React 19.3.1 对过数。
desc.en: Clicking a button and calling setCount(c => c + 1) does not edit a single DOM node right away. Following the React 19.3.1 source, this essay unpacks that line: immutable JSX element objects, the Fiber linked list and double buffering, two-pass O(n) list diffing and keys, hooks as a call-ordered linked list, subtreeFlags bubbling, the three commit phases and effect timing, root event delegation and microtask batching, 31-bit Lane scheduling, and the November 2026 frontier across React Compiler, Server Components, Activity, and View Transitions. Nine hands-on models implement the same algorithms and check them against React 19.3.1 itself.

title.zh: Render 与 Commit 两阶段更新

desc.zh: 调用 setState 不会立刻改 DOM：React 先在内存草稿树 workInProgress 上可中断地计算差异，再在同步的 Commit 阶段一次性改写 DOM 并切换 root.current。
desc.en: Calling setState does not mutate the DOM right away: React computes diffs interruptibly on an off-screen workInProgress tree, then mutates the DOM and flips root.current synchronously in Commit.

zh: React 为什么不直接改 DOM

title.zh: JSX 与 React Element 对象

desc.zh: JSX 只是 jsx() 函数调用的语法糖，只返回包含 $$typeof、type、key 和 props 的轻量描述对象；组件函数并不拥有 DOM 节点。
desc.en: JSX compiles into jsx() calls returning lightweight read-only objects with $$typeof, type, key, and props; components never own DOM nodes directly.

title.zh: Fiber 链表与双缓冲架构
title.en: Fiber linked list and double buffering

desc.zh: React 用 child、sibling 和 return 指针把树扁平化为可中断遍历的链表，并用 alternate 连接 current 与 workInProgress 两棵树实现 5 ms 时间切片。
desc.en: React flattens the tree with child, sibling, and return pointers so traversal can yield every 5 ms, and pairs current with workInProgress via alternate for double buffering.

title.zh: O(n) 列表协调与 key 身份识别

desc.zh: React 通过同层两轮遍历（先按位置匹配，再建 existingChildren Map 查表）将树 Diff 降至 O(n)；使用数组下标作 key 会在插入或排序时导致组件本地状态错位。
desc.en: React reduces tree diffing to O(n) via a two-pass sibling scan and an existingChildren Map; using array index as key mispairs local state across prepends and reorders.

zh: React 列表为什么要加 key
不能用 index 当 key 的原因
en: why not use index as key

title.zh: Hook 链表与环形更新队列
title.en: Hooks linked list and circular queue

desc.zh: 函数组件没有实例状态，React 将所有 Hook 按调用序号串在 fiber.memoizedState 单链表上，并把 setState 更新挂入 queue.pending 单向循环链表。
desc.en: With no component instance, React chains Hooks sequentially on fiber.memoizedState and queues state updates into a circular singly-linked queue.pending ring.

zh: useState 为什么不能写在 if 里

title.zh: beginWork / completeWork 与子树脏标记

desc.zh: Render 阶段向下走进 beginWork、向上收尾 completeWork 时把子节点 flags 按位 OR 进 subtreeFlags，使 Commit 能跳过干净子树。
desc.en: During render, completeWork bubbles child flags upward via bitwise OR into subtreeFlags so the commit phase skips untouched subtrees outright.

title.zh: Commit 三阶段与 useLayoutEffect vs useEffect

desc.zh: Commit 同步走完 beforeMutation、mutation 和 layout 后才交还给浏览器绘制：useLayoutEffect 在绘制前同步运行可防闪烁但阻塞出画，useEffect 在绘制后异步运行。
desc.en: Commit runs beforeMutation, mutation, and layout synchronously before browser paint: useLayoutEffect runs pre-paint to prevent flicker at the cost of blocking paint, while useEffect runs post-paint.

zh: 为什么 useEffect 会闪烁
React 生命周期执行顺序

title.zh: 根容器事件委托与微任务自动合批
title.en: Root event delegation and automatic batching

desc.zh: React 在根容器注册统一监听并通过 __reactFiber$ 沿 return 链模拟捕获与冒泡，同时通过微任务把同一轮里的多次 setState 合并为一次提交。
desc.en: React attaches delegated listeners at the root container, walks return pointers via __reactFiber$ for synthetic capture/bubble, and batches setState calls inside one microtask.

zh: stopPropagation 在 React 里失效

title.zh: 31 位 Lanes 优先级与并发抢占

desc.zh: React 用 31 位比特掩码追踪不同紧迫度的更新，借 lanes & -lanes 提取最高优车道，使 SyncLane 按键能抢占 startTransition 慢渲染。
desc.en: React tracks mixed-urgency updates with a 31-bit Lane bitmask and lanes & -lanes, letting SyncLane keystrokes preempt time-sliced startTransition renders.

title.en: React Compiler, RSC, Activity, and ViewTransition

desc.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月的 React 19 前沿：Compiler 1.0 通过 useMemoCache(size) 自动记忆化，RSC 通过 Flight 线协议流式传树，19.2–19.3 带来 Activity 与 ViewTransition。
desc.en: React 19 frontier as of November 2026: React Compiler 1.0 emits useMemoCache(size) slot caches, RSC streams trees over Flight chunks, and 19.2–19.3 stabilize Activity and ViewTransition.
